mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ebook_snapshot (ebook_id, `date`, view_count, vote_count, view_increase, vote_increase) SELECT e.id, CURDATE(), e.view_count, e.vote_count, e.view_count - COALESCE(y.view_count, 0), e.vote_count - COALESCE(y.vote_count, 0) FROM ebook e LEFT JOIN ebook_snapshot y ON y.ebook_id = e.id AND y.`date` = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ebook_snapshot s WHERE s.ebook_id = e.id AND s.`date` = CURDATE() )
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(view_count), 0) AS view_count, COALESCE(SUM(vote_count), 0) AS vote_count FROM ebook_snapshot WHERE `date` = CURDATE()
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(view_count), 0) AS view_count, COALESCE(SUM(vote_count), 0) AS vote_count FROM ebook_snapshot WHERE `date` = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(view_count), 0) AS view_count, COALESCE(SUM(vote_count), 0) AS vote_count FROM ebook

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(`date`, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COALESCE(SUM(view_increase), 0) AS viewIncrease, COALESCE(SUM(vote_increase), 0) AS voteIncrease FROM ebook_snapshot WHERE `date` >= #{startDate} GROUP BY `date` ORDER BY `date`
